digest.component_or_area: binding_walk reconciler, Jira inbound-create adopt path
propositions: Jira rebar-id label is written before local CREATE event and binding are durably published, creating a crash window where ephemeral runner push rejection causes local state loss while Jira label persists.

When the final push is rejected on an ephemeral runner, binding_walk's L10 guard skips adopt due to the label presence, and no healing path can recover the marked-but-unstored local ticket and binding.

The recovery extension detects a marked-but-unstored key (rebar-id label equals deterministic inbound local id, no binding-store entry, no local ticket) and replays the adopt through the existing inbound-create leaf instead of standing down.
Idempotent replay of the adopt through _apply_inbound_create re-materializes the local ticket and binding under the same deterministic local id without creating duplicate labels or double-binds.
